x: Dave Smith, back from injury, muscled the hammer over 70m and new member, John Urquhart secured a good fourth place in the 'B' event to ensure better points than Match 1.
John Urquhart returned after a winter's retirement to win the 'B' event and so ensure that as usual the hammer squad got us off to a great start.

So let's start by paying special tribute to; John Urquhart who can still throw a mean hammer; Matt Yates who could have scored good high jump points as he twanged his hamstring in the 800m but continued for 4 points; Jim Estall who coasted the 1500m in flats and had only come to watch Junior Galley…
